tools.name: ob_list_profiles
tools.description: List configured OceanBase MCP profiles with redacted settings.

tools.name: ob_config_diagnostics
tools.description: Check profile, policy, TLS, HTTP, and production hardening settings.

tools.name: ob_check_opencode_setup
tools.description: Check local OpenCode config, OceanBase agent, and query skill files for the current project.

tools.name: ob_get_usage_guide
tools.description: Return the recommended read-only OpenCode workflow, safety rules, and MySQL/Oracle notes.

tools.name: ob_list_capabilities
tools.description: List supported tool groups, tool versions, active compatibility mode, and read-only limits.

tools.name: ob_refresh_metadata_cache
tools.description: Clear in-memory metadata cache entries for the active profile, optionally scoped by schema or table.

tools.name: ob_get_cache_status
tools.description: Return profile-scoped metadata cache settings and counters without exposing cached content.

tools.name: ob_verify_permissions
tools.description: Inspect current database grants and report whether the account appears read-only.

tools.name: ob_ping
tools.description: Verify the configured OceanBase connection.

tools.name: ob_policy_explain
tools.description: Explain whether a SQL statement is allowed and which read-only or access-policy checks apply.

tools.name: ob_query_preview
tools.description: Preview policy, sensitive-column, and EXPLAIN risk for a read-only SQL statement without executing the target query.

tools.name: ob_query
tools.description: Run a strictly read-only SQL statement against OceanBase.

tools.name: ob_query_page
tools.description: Run a strictly read-only SELECT/WITH query with server-side pagination.

tools.name: ob_start_query_session
tools.description: Create an in-memory read-only query context for follow-up paging, refinement, and summarization.

tools.name: ob_get_query_session
tools.description: Return a read-only query session context without exposing stored parameter values.

tools.name: ob_close_query_session
tools.description: Close an in-memory query session for the selected profile.

tools.name: ob_query_next_page
tools.description: Run the next page for a read-only query session without bypassing row, timeout, output, or policy limits.

tools.name: ob_query_prev_page
tools.description: Run the previous page for a read-only query session without bypassing row, timeout, output, or policy limits.

tools.name: ob_query_refine
tools.description: Build a refined read-only SELECT from a query session using structured columns, filters, ordering, and pagination without executing it.

tools.name: ob_summarize_result
tools.description: Summarize already returned query rows without reading the database.

tools.name: ob_compare_query_results
tools.description: Compare two already returned query results without reading the database or storing row values.

tools.name: ob_export_result_preview
tools.description: Generate a bounded Markdown or CSV preview string from already returned rows without writing files.

tools.name: ob_explain
tools.description: Run EXPLAIN for a strictly read-only SQL statement.

tools.name: ob_analyze_query_plan
tools.description: Run EXPLAIN for a strictly read-only SQL statement and return evidence-based plan findings.

tools.name: ob_generate_performance_report
tools.description: Generate a read-only SQL performance advisory report from EXPLAIN, table statistics, and index metadata.

tools.name: ob_build_select
tools.description: Build a parameterized read-only SELECT from validated table, columns, filters, ordering, and pagination without executing it.

tools.name: ob_generate_query
tools.description: Generate read-only SQL templates from policy-filtered table metadata without executing them.

tools.name: ob_generate_query_examples
tools.description: Generate scenario-based read-only SQL examples from policy-filtered table metadata without executing them.

tools.name: ob_find_recent_rows
tools.description: Read recent rows from an allowed table using an explicit or metadata-detected time column with safe pagination.

tools.name: ob_list_schemas
tools.description: List schemas/databases visible to the current OceanBase user, filtered by access policy.

tools.name: ob_list_tables
tools.description: List tables visible to the current OceanBase user, filtered by access policy.

tools.name: ob_describe_table
tools.description: Return column metadata for an allowed OceanBase table.

tools.name: ob_get_schema_map
tools.description: Return a compact, policy-filtered schema map with table summaries, key fields, and relationship hints.

tools.name: ob_get_database_dictionary
tools.description: Generate a bounded JSON or Markdown data dictionary from visible table and column metadata.

tools.name: ob_find_related_tables
tools.description: Find foreign-key and conservative naming-based relationships for an allowed OceanBase table.

tools.name: ob_generate_data_dictionary
tools.description: Generate bounded JSON, Markdown, or simple HTML data dictionary output from visible metadata.

tools.name: ob_search_catalog
tools.description: Search schemas, tables, columns, and comments, filtered by access policy.

tools.name: ob_find_tables_by_business_term
tools.description: Find visible candidate tables from a business term using glossary, catalog metadata, comments, and relationship evidence.

tools.name: ob_search_everything
tools.description: Search visible schemas, tables, columns, comments, and business glossary entries with confidence and evidence.

tools.name: ob_search_business_glossary
tools.description: Search optional business terms mapped to allowed OceanBase schemas, tables, and columns.

tools.name: ob_find_columns
tools.description: Find visible columns across tables by name, comment, data type, table pattern, or business term.

tools.name: ob_get_table_schema
tools.description: Return policy-filtered table columns and types for one table.

tools.name: ob_get_table_ddl
tools.description: Return native or structured DDL metadata for an allowed OceanBase table.

tools.name: ob_get_table_stats
tools.description: Return table-level optimizer statistics and metadata counts for an allowed OceanBase table.

tools.name: ob_get_table_summary
tools.description: Return a compact table summary with inferred purpose, key fields, relationship hints, and query entry points.

tools.name: ob_get_indexes
tools.description: Return indexes for an allowed OceanBase table.

tools.name: ob_get_constraints
tools.description: Return constraints for an allowed OceanBase table.

tools.name: ob_get_partitions
tools.description: Return partition metadata for an allowed OceanBase table.

tools.name: ob_sample_rows
tools.description: Return a small, policy-filtered sample from an allowed table. Sensitive-looking fields are always masked.

tools.name: ob_get_table_context
tools.description: Return the common read-only table context needed for SQL drafting and data inspection.

tools.name: ob_list_objects
tools.description: List policy-filtered Oracle object metadata such as views, sequences, synonyms, procedures, functions, and packages.

tools.name: ob_get_object_metadata
tools.description: Return bounded, policy-filtered metadata for one Oracle view, sequence, synonym, procedure, function, or package.

tools.name: ob_detect_time_columns
tools.description: Detect likely create, update, and business time columns from visible table metadata.

tools.name: ob_detect_dimension_columns
tools.description: Detect likely status, type, channel, region, flag, and category columns from visible table metadata.

tools.name: ob_capture_metadata_snapshot
tools.description: Capture a bounded metadata-only OceanBase snapshot for later offline diff and impact analysis.

tools.name: ob_compare_metadata_snapshots
tools.description: Compare two metadata-only snapshots and return evidence-based structural changes.

tools.name: ob_analyze_change_sql_impact
tools.description: Analyze which indexed project SQL snippets are impacted by a metadata snapshot diff.

tools.name: ob_analyze_metadata_impact
tools.description: Summarize metadata diff impact using optional SQL usage index and business glossary evidence.

tools.name: ob_generate_metadata_change_report
tools.description: Generate a Markdown or simple HTML metadata change report from diff and impact evidence.

tools.name: ob_compare_tables
tools.description: Compare two visible tables by columns, indexes, constraints, and partitions.

tools.name: ob_compare_schemas
tools.description: Compare two visible schemas by table list and bounded per-table metadata differences.

tools.name: ob_convert_sql_dialect
tools.description: Convert read-only SQL between OceanBase MySQL and Oracle modes with documented limitations.

tools.name: ob_explain_error
tools.description: Explain a SQL error with policy context and visible metadata hints without executing the SQL.

tools.name: ob_lint_sql
tools.description: Lint read-only SQL for policy, dialect, pagination, ordering, sensitive fields, and optional EXPLAIN risk without returning data.

tools.name: ob_rewrite_sql
tools.description: Rewrite SELECT/WITH SQL into a safer read-only form without executing it.

tools.name: ob_find_sql_usages
tools.description: Find project SQL usages from a static SQL usage index without executing SQL or reading project files.

tools.name: ob_validate_sql_snippet
tools.description: Validate a pasted read-only SQL snippet for policy, dialect, pagination, plan risk, and visible table or column metadata.

tools.name: ob_explain_project_query
tools.description: Explain a read-only SQL snippet from text or a local project file without executing it.

tools.name: ob_generate_query_doc
tools.description: Generate bounded JSON or Markdown documentation for a SQL snippet without executing the target query.

tools.name: ob_generate_mapper_context
tools.description: Generate read-only table and column context for a MyBatis mapper, SQL file, or explicit table.

tools.name: ob_find_unknown_columns_in_sql
tools.description: Find unknown tables or columns in SQL and return visible metadata-based candidates without executing the SQL.

tools.name: ob_prepare_query
tools.description: Prepare candidate tables, fields, read-only SQL drafts, and safety previews from visible metadata without executing the target query.

tools.name: ob_profile_table
tools.description: Return a bounded table-level profile with metadata counts, key fields, time/status fields, and sampled null overview.

tools.name: ob_profile_columns
tools.description: Return bounded, policy-filtered column profiles for an allowed OceanBase table.

tools.name: ob_get_value_distribution
tools.description: Return bounded top-value distribution for one allowed column, with masking and sample limits enforced.

tools.name: ob_check_data_quality
tools.description: Run bounded read-only data quality checks for nulls, duplicate key risk, dimensions, and time columns.

tools.name: ob_generate_table_doc
tools.description: Generate bounded JSON or Markdown documentation for one visible table without returning sample values.

tools.name: ob_generate_schema_doc
tools.description: Generate bounded JSON or Markdown documentation for visible tables in one schema.

tools.name: ob_generate_onboarding_doc
tools.description: Generate bounded onboarding documentation from visible OceanBase metadata and optional business glossary hints.

tools.name: ob_explain_relationship
tools.description: Explain visible relationship evidence between two OceanBase tables without inventing missing relationships.

tools.name: ob_generate_er_diagram
tools.description: Generate Mermaid and JSON ER metadata from allowed OceanBase table metadata and relationships.

tools.name: ob_generate_er_document
tools.description: Generate Markdown, PlantUML, and DOT documentation from allowed ER metadata and relationship evidence.

tools.name: ob_generate_entity_diagram
tools.description: Generate a local entity-focused ER diagram from a business term or table, with Mermaid, JSON, and optional HTML.

tools.name: ob_plan_er_export
tools.description: Plan local ER HTML export commands for large OceanBase schemas without returning large inline HTML.

tools.name: ob_generate_er_html
tools.description: Generate a self-contained HTML ER diagram from allowed OceanBase metadata and relationship evidence.
